title: From the other side of the console
body: I listened to the trailer for the dispatcher episode in the cab between calls. We hear Marcus's voice a dozen times a night and I have never seen his face. Please ask him what he has for lunch at 3 a.m.
reply: We did. You will have to wait until Thursday.

title: The 1963 entries
body: My father tended the Ash Canal bridge in the winter of 1963. Some of the entries Petra read out are his handwriting. I would know that seven anywhere.
reply: Walter, Petra would like to meet you. We have passed on your letter.
summary: My father tended the Ash Canal bridge in the winter of 1963. Some of the entries Petra read out are his handwriting. I would know that seven anywhere.

title: Seventy-two percent
body: For the record, I was right about the hydration.
reply: Joe, your letter has been passed to Dellah. She has asked us not to print her reply.
summary: For the record, I was right about the hydration.

title: Ward 7B
body: I work nights on a ward two hundred miles from Corran and every word Agnes said was true. The handover is the job.
reply: Thank you. Agnes asked us to say: eat something that is not from the vending machine.
summary: I work nights on a ward two hundred miles from Corran and every word Agnes said was true. The handover is the job.

title: Route 12
body: I drive the first bus up Cobbler Hill. I did not know Hal's name until this episode. I will wave now.
reply: Hal says he will flash the lights.
summary: I drive the first bus up Cobbler Hill. I did not know Hal's name until this episode. I will wave now.

title: Toast
body: Toast. Always toast. Thank you for printing that.
reply: It was the most agreed-upon finding of the season.
summary: Toast. Always toast. Thank you for printing that.

title: Desmond
body: Wren is right. If I do not call she worries. I called from a layby to tell her I heard the episode.
reply: Wren read your letter on air the next Tuesday at ten past two.
summary: Wren is right. If I do not call she worries. I called from a layby to tell her I heard the episode.

title: The bell
body: I have bought at Saltgate for twelve years and I have never heard the bell from the porters' side. Thank you for the full tape.
reply: The unedited bell is in the members' back room, all twenty-six minutes.
summary: I have bought at Saltgate for twelve years and I have never heard the bell from the porters' side. Thank you for the full tape.
